verdict.rationale: The vendor README claims 'full SSR and serverless support' with streaming and progressive hydration, but no evidence pack details on specific deployment adapters for edge/serverless platforms (e.g., Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare) or confirms zero custom infra setup. Community evidence also flags SolidStart routing as 'very slow with no workaround' and docs/dev tools as immature, undercutting confidence in a smooth serverless deployment story.
